scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && pnpm install
scripts.deps:docker:all: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:migration:list: bash -c 'set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && DB_URL="${DATABASE_URL/postgresql+asyncpg/postgresql}"; DB_URL="${DB_URL/:6543/:5432}"; supabase migration list --db-url "$DB_URL"'
scripts.predev: pnpm run check:celery && pnpm run db:check && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.preprod: pnpm run verify:supabase && pnpm run check:prod && pnpm run check:celery && pnpm run db:check:prod && pnpm run db:migrate:prod
scripts.dev: pnpm run deps:docker:all && pnpm run check:env && concurrently -k -n api,worker -c blue,magenta "pnpm run api" "pnpm run worker"
scripts.prod: concurrently -k -n api,worker -c blue,magenta "pnpm run api:prod" "pnpm run worker:prod"
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run deps:docker && pnpm run setup && pnpm run db:migrate
